cases.title: Nexitally-shaped full profile
cases.claim: A managed full Quantumult X config keeps only the first [server_local] servers and drops banners, the duplicate, and later sections.

cases.title: English and Chinese info banners
cases.claim: Traffic / Expire / Reset / Days Left / 流量 / 到期 / 剩余 / 套餐 / [Premium] are DROP_EXCLUDED.

cases.title: Reset substring trap
cases.claim: HK-Reset-01 and Preset are excluded because Reset is a substring; HK-RST-01 is kept.

cases.title: Days Left vs DaysLeft
cases.claim: The exclusion token is the two-word phrase Days Left. DaysLeft is kept.

cases.title: [Premium] as a later header
cases.claim: A [Premium] INI header terminates [server_local]; nodes after it are OUTSIDE_SECTION.

cases.title: Filter section after servers
cases.claim: The first [filter_local] header ends the capture. Filter rules are not leaked into the server resource.

cases.title: First of two [server_local] blocks
cases.claim: Only the first [server_local] block is read.

cases.title: Section is last in the file
cases.claim: A [server_local] block that runs to EOF is captured in full.

cases.title: Mixed-case header
cases.claim: [Server_Local] matches because the header regex is case-insensitive.

cases.title: Indented header
cases.claim: Leading whitespace before [server_local] is allowed.

cases.title: Header without a following newline
cases.claim: [server_local] with no newline after the closing bracket is ERROR_NO_SECTION.

cases.title: Glued header
cases.claim: [server_local]anytls=... is not a section header followed by a newline.

cases.title: Inner-spaced header
cases.claim: [server local] does not match [server_local].

cases.title: No [server_local] section
cases.claim: A profile that only has [server_remote] / [policy] returns the missing-section error.

cases.title: Section with no usable servers
cases.claim: Comments and banners alone produce the no-usable-servers error.

cases.title: Premium and traffic placeholders only
cases.claim: A [Premium] stub plus traffic rows is ERROR_NO_USABLE.

cases.title: Official seven-prefix roster
cases.claim: anytls, shadowsocks, vmess, vless, trojan, http, and socks5 official samples are kept.

cases.title: AnyTLS Reality sample
cases.claim: The official Reality AnyTLS line is kept as a normal anytls= server.

cases.title: Comments and exact duplicates
cases.claim: ; # // comments drop. A second copy of the same trimmed line is DROP_DUPLICATE.

cases.title: UTF-8 BOM and CRLF
cases.claim: A BOM and Windows newlines are normalized before the section regex runs.

cases.title: Unsupported families
cases.claim: wireguard, hysteria2, tuic, and ssr= prefixes are DROP_UNSUPPORTED. shadowsocks + ssr-protocol is kept.

cases.title: Policy lines inside the section
cases.claim: static= / available= lines are not server schemes.

cases.title: Filter rules inside the section
cases.claim: host, and ip-cidr, lines inside [server_local] are DROP_UNSUPPORTED.

cases.title: HTML login page
cases.claim: An HTML body has no [server_local] header and errors.

cases.title: Clash YAML
cases.claim: A Clash proxies document is not a Quantumult X profile.

cases.title: Servers only under [server_remote]
cases.claim: The parser looks for [server_local], not [server_remote].

cases.title: Preamble then section
cases.claim: Vendor banners before [server_local] are OUTSIDE_SECTION and do not block a later valid section.

cases.title: Scheme case and spacing
cases.claim: ANYTLS = and ShadowSocks= are kept. A space before = is allowed.

cases.title: IPv6 and tab padding
cases.claim: A documented IPv6 literal and a tab-indented server line are kept after trim.

cases.title: Long official TLS params
cases.claim: Official tls-pubkey-sha256 / Reality fields do not confuse the prefix matcher.
